image_description: Two compact audio cassettes lying side-by-side on a white surface. The left cassette has a colorful abstract label with pink and orange stripes; the right cassette features a 'K7' logo and text indicating '60 mins'. Both have transparent plastic casings revealing internal spools and tape mechanisms. The image is a close-up, slightly high-angle shot.
